يشجوا (form I)
# يَشُجُّوا (yašujjū) /ja.ʃud͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
# يَشِجُّوا (yašijjū) /ja.ʃid͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
# يُشَجُّوا (yušajjū) /ju.ʃad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَجَّ (šajja)
